correctness.rationale: Complete matrix-exponential solution; logarithmic derivative D has a positive-to-negative crossing and every possible zero has strictly negative curvature given by an exact rational identity. An entire positive-coefficient power series forces D_r<0. Endpoint, zero-contrast and limiting cases are proved. Standalone checker independently matches the exact algebra and 100 matrix exponentials, passing 1,444 assertions. Numerical sampling is supplementary; all-parameter conclusions are analytical.

value.rationale: The fixed-time receiver concentration is a natural, directly interpretable tracer monitoring quantity. The exact result shows the counterintuitive finite optimum for every unequal local loss pair, classifies the equal-loss boundary and the entire monotone optimum vs contrast, and gives a universal lower bound kT>1. It informs interpretation of two-box water-quality exchanges without asserting nonlinear, spatial, or field-level validity.
